text:
No option can be put forward from this run, because it did not test whether monthly churn stays below 4%.

- The comparison is otherwise robust under the changes tested, but that is not evidence of churn compliance.
- It also ranked options by higher modelled MRR because the goal direction was not explicitly represented; the £20k/month threshold could not be assessed in the analysis frame.
- The comparison rests materially on machine-authored estimates for the Pro subscriber base, new Pro sign-ups, monthly churn, and feature-release value. The subscriber-base assumption has the greatest modelled influence.
